title.narrative: Investing in realizing SDG 2030 (HIV-TB) goal - Zanzibar (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Zanzibar, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar (Ministry of Health, Zanzibar)This program has the following goals: Reduce HIV incidence and mortality by 85% and 80% respectively, compared to 2010 by 2028 (GAS). Reduce HIV incidence to 0.025 per 1000 uninfected populations per year by 2028 (WHO). Achieve the elimination of vertical (mother-to-child) transmission of two of either HIV and hepatitis B HIV and syphilis by 2028(WHO). Reduce TB incidence and mortality by 80% and 90% respectively (compared to 2015) by 2028 (End TB). The objectives of this program are: 95% of Key & Vulnerable Populations saturated with a minimum package of combination prevention interventions by 2025. 95% of eligible PWID are receiving MAT service by 2025 onwards. 95% of people with a substantial risk of HIV acquisition receive PreP by 2025 onwards. Reduce HIV transmission rates from mother to child to below 1% by 2025. Increase TB preventive treatment coverage among eligible people to at least 95% by 2028.. Sustain treatment success rate for DS-TB and DR-TB at 95% or above and 100% respectively through 2027.. Increase TB treatment coverage for DS-TB and DR-TB from 66% in 2021 to 80% and from 53 to 90% respectively by 2027. Increase TB preventive treatment coverage among eligible people to at least 95% by 2028.
